clips.title: Foundation
clips.prompt: Hyper-realistic macro miniature construction, satisfying DIY timelapse energy. A round wooden diorama base on a craftsman's workbench, soft window light, scattered tools: tweezers, a glue bottle, a small trowel. A pair of careful hands sets tiny cut stones one by one into a wet plaster foundation ring, pressing each flush with a fingertip, excess plaster squeezing between joints. Stone dust, a coffee-stained blueprint underneath, a jar of pebbles. Warm daylight from the left with soft shadow. Extreme macro lens gliding slowly along the foundation ring, 100mm macro, shallow focus rolling across the stones. Crisp detail, gentle motion, 24fps.

clips.title: Framing
clips.prompt: Hyper-realistic macro miniature construction, satisfying DIY timelapse energy. The same round diorama base, its stone foundation ring now set and dry, on the same workbench in soft window light. A pair of hands lifts a delicate basswood timber frame wall and lowers it precisely onto the foundation, tiny beams and door opening visible, a drop of wood glue glistening at each joint as tweezers press the corners square. Wood shavings curl on the bench, a miniature spirit level rests nearby. Warm daylight with soft shadow. Slow macro orbit around the rising frame, 100mm macro, shallow focus. Crisp detail, gentle motion, 24fps.
